phase: implementation; waiting for owner implementation handoffs and parent verification authorization

01.title: protected subframes
01.acceptance: Hidden data/blob frames preserve main DOM and screenshot; safely identify skipped frame/reason; protected main documents remain denied; visible protected frames masked or screenshot withheld, never leaked.

02.title: semantic DOM coverage
02.acceptance: Generic custom elements/open shadow/display:contents/zero-box/clipping fixtures expose rendered controls; coverage distinct truncation; accessible live YouTube compared to screenshot or explicit access limitation.

03.title: bounded navigation
03.acceptance: Pending-load rendered fixture retains owned tab ID, navigation_status timeout and usable observation/cleanup; configurable wait_until/timeout_ms; no infinite retry.

04.title: recovery policy
04.acceptance: Snapshot-bound reload recommendation explains data loss/default host approval; host-only exact-origin exception requires complete DOM error evidence and no unsaved/editable/sensitive evidence; custom Refresh remains normal risky click.

05.title: network inspection
05.acceptance: Real browser captures UI-hidden HTTP503 response distinctly from requestfailed with redirects/timing/content-type; bounded tab-scoped cursor/filter and listener cleanup; no default body/auth/cookies/postdata.

06.title: application WebSocket inspection
06.acceptance: Real open/sent/received/ping/pong/binary/close/error opcode and size events without UI disclosure; scoped cursor/filter/cleanup, capture_started_at/incomplete_history; host-and-call opt-in bounded redacted text, binary metadata only.

07.title: target-local pixels
07.acceptance: Unrelated animation outside observed target permits action, target change rejects with region diagnostic; preserve semantic/geometry/occlusion, exact target pixel compare, no tolerance/replay.

08.title: parent semantic progress
08.acceptance: DOM/vision provenance distinct; unprimed arbitrary visual-only text through actual local HTTP multimodal provider fixture clearly labeled, recovery approval required; parent progress before final across stdio/modern+legacy HTTP/JSONL/OMP; cancellation preserves unrelated session.

shared_contracts.observation: coverage {status:complete|partial|unknown,reasons,dom_elements} separate from text truncation; page_state DOM evidence; screenshot page viewport, not desktop
shared_contracts.monitors: BrowserSession monitor_start/list/stop; network_start/list/stop and websocket_start/list/stop exposed; max_events=256,limit=100,url_filter optional; payloads false,max_payload_bytes=512
shared_contracts.recovery: BROWSER_RECOVERY_POLICY host JSON reload_without_approval_origins; no caller policy authority; reload exact revision/action approval default
shared_contracts.vision: interpret_visual false default; opt-in captures PNG and performs configured multimodal text call; source vision/self_reported_confidence not calibrated; DOM and vision separate
shared_contracts.progress: async on_progress event callback, monotonic bounded seq/page_state/step/status; MCP per-call _meta.progressToken; JSONL progress true interim id/progress; OMP interim onUpdate not final response
